question: Q2
title: Is a cited capture a website?
label: Tested, not independently verified
population: Our export of 2026-10-11: 24,679 records 1996 to 2001 (registrable and hostname), 14,140,106 records 2002 to 2013, each with its cited capture.
query: GET /web/<ts>id_/<original>, Wayback timestamp hops followed; the Memento-Datetime year must equal the record year.
result: 110 of 150 (73%) show site content; 1 from another year
finding: A 2xx or 3xx status alone does not make a capture a website: 39 of 150 cited captures are redirects, placeholders, empty pages or error text.
limits: Markers are simple string tests on the first 1 MB, so keyword pages of wildcard hosts pass as site content. Redirect targets are not fetched or judged.
